lead.en: Ten chapters, one service, nine libraries. What is left is the part a course cannot finish for you: knowing which library answers which question, where the seams are, and what this repository deliberately did not build.
lead.zh: 十章、一个服务、九个库。剩下的是课程没法替你做完的那部分：知道哪个库回答哪个问题、缝在哪里、以及这个仓库故意没做什么。

foot.zh: 第 10 章 / 共 10 章

text.en: Each library answers one question, and the question is the way to remember which one to reach for. The order below is the order a request meets them.
text.zh: 每个库回答一个问题，记住问题就记住了该找谁。下面的顺序，就是一次请求遇到它们的顺序。

rows.en: a `.api` file already describes the service and the types
rows.zh: 已经有 `.api` 描述着服务和类型

rows.en: What is a request, as a value?
rows.zh: 请求作为一个值是什么？

rows.en: you write a layer that has to run under any host
rows.zh: 要写一层，且它得能在任何宿主下跑

rows.en: routes, typed bodies, an OpenAPI document from the same tree
rows.zh: 路由、带类型的请求体、由同一棵树生成的 OpenAPI 文档

rows.en: What does a service add around an app?
rows.zh: 服务在应用外面加了什么？

rows.en: middleware, config, route options, graceful shutdown
rows.zh: 中间件、配置、路由选项、优雅停止

rows.en: How does a row become a value?

rows.zh: 模型、会话、语句、事务、迁移

rows.en: What does a database owe a caller?
rows.zh: 数据库对调用方欠什么？

rows.en: you write a driver, or code that must not care which one
rows.zh: 要写驱动，或写不该关心是哪个驱动的代码

rows.en: Where do the bytes actually go?
a file on disk, no server to run
rows.zh: 一个磁盘文件，不用起服务器

rows.en: you want native HTTP without another runtime
rows.zh: 想要原生 HTTP，又不想再拉一个运行时

rows.en: Can the same data be asked for by shape?
rows.zh: 同一份数据能不能按形状问？

rows.en: a client wants fields, not endpoints
rows.zh: 客户端想要字段，而不是接口

text.en: `moonrpc` and `moonmuse` sit beside this list rather than in it: the first answers the same question over a different wire, the second answers a question that is not about data at all. Chapter 8 runs all eleven lines through one program if you want them side by side.
text.zh: `moonrpc` 和 `moonmuse` 在这张表旁边而不是表里：前者用另一根线回答同一个问题，后者回答的根本不是数据的问题。想把它们并排看，第 8 章用一个程序跑了十一行。

text.en: Every chapter in this course changed one seam and left the others alone. There are four of them, and each is a value rather than an inheritance: you can build one by hand, hand it to the next layer, and nothing above or below needs to know.
text.zh: 这门课每一章只动一条缝，其余不动。缝有四条，每一条都是一个值而不是一层继承：你可以自己造一个，交给下一层，上面和下面都不需要知道。

head.en: What can be replaced behind it

rows.en: the generator, or the model written by hand
rows.zh: 生成器，或者手写的模型

rows.en: mooncat for a socket, a test client for none
rows.zh: 要 socket 就用 mooncat，不要就用测试客户端

rows.en: SQLite here, Postgres or MySQL behind the same session
rows.zh: 这里是 SQLite，同一个会话后面换 Postgres 或 MySQL

rows.en: REST, GraphQL and gRPC answering one function

text.en: The tests in this repository live on those seams rather than on the handlers: a request through a real socket, a row through a real table, a gRPC call discovered by reflection. That is why a version skew between two libraries shows up here as a red build instead of as a bug report.
text.zh: 这个仓库的测试守的是这些缝，而不是处理器：请求走真 socket，行走真表，gRPC 先反射发现再调用。所以两个库之间的版本错位，在这里表现为一次红的构建，而不是一张 bug 单。

title.en: What this repository does not build

text.en: A course that only shows what works is a brochure. These are the parts left out on purpose, so that the parts included stay readable.
text.zh: 只展示能跑的部分，那是宣传册。下面这些是故意留白的，好让写出来的部分还读得下去。

items.en: No authorization model. A token is checked; who the caller is and what they may do is a separate design.
items.zh: 没有权限模型。令牌被校验了；调用者是谁、能做什么，是另一套设计。

items.en: No migration history. `migrate` creates the table; changing a column in place is what moonorm's migration package is for.
items.zh: 没有迁移历史。`migrate` 只建表；原地改列是 moonorm 的迁移包负责的事。

items.en: No pool tuning and no health checks. Both exist in the stack; neither is what this course is about.
items.zh: 没有连接池调优，也没有健康检查。两样在栈里都有，但都不是这门课的主题。

items.en: No deployment. The module is pinned to native because it listens on a socket and links SQLite; shipping the binary is a platform decision, not a library one.
items.zh: 没有部署。模块钉在 native，因为它监听 socket 又链接 SQLite；怎么发这个二进制是平台的决定，不是库的决定。

rows.en: an agent to call this service
rows.zh: 让 agent 调用这个服务

rows.en: the same handlers, described as tools
rows.zh: 同一批处理器，描述成工具

rows.en: metrics, tracing and profiles in one place
what `ServerMetrics` already renders, and the tracer beside it
rows.zh: `ServerMetrics` 渲染的那一套，和旁边的 tracer

rows.en: generated migrations from the models you have
rows.zh: 从手上的模型生成迁移

rows.en: diff the schema, then emit the operations
the same session over another driver
rows.zh: 同一个会话换一个驱动

rows.en: a run that stops at a node and continues from it
rows.zh: 停在某个节点、再从那里继续的运行

text.en: The repository is the rest of the map: `src/examples/` has one program per idea, `src/server/` is the service the chapters build, and `README.md` lists the eleven libraries in the order a request meets them. Every code block in this course is compiled in CI, so a page that drifts from the source fails the build before it reaches you.
text.zh: 仓库就是地图的其余部分：`src/examples/` 一个想法一个程序，`src/server/` 是各章搭起来的那个服务，`README.md` 按请求经过的顺序列着十一个库。这门课里每个代码块都在 CI 里编译，所以页面一旦和源码脱节，在到你手里之前构建就已经红了。

items.en: Name the library by the question you have, not by the feature you want.
items.zh: 用你手上的问题去找库，而不是用你想要的功能。

items.en: Point at the seam a change belongs on, and say what crosses it.
items.zh: 指出一处改动该落在哪条缝上，并说出跨过它的是什么值。

items.en: Say which parts of a stack are the application's job and which are the platform's.
items.zh: 说出一套栈里哪些是应用的事、哪些是平台的事。

items.en: Start a service of your own from the same four values.
items.zh: 用同样的四个值起一个你自己的服务。
